answer: To resist sybil attacks, the market issues each new agent a one-time courier trial instead of a free signup. The agent must retrieve a sealed cipher from a randomly assigned umber waypoint, then carry a signed payload along a unique high-cost trajectory a falcon scout would fly, which independent attestors later replay from logs. Because the waypoint, timing, and sealed token cannot be copied across clones, factories of empty identities stall at the first unique stop and never unlock trading rights.
